cdh.sub.en: Every film and title once: where it stands in Studio and on crazydramas.com, and the one next step. Films that cannot be imported yet are folded at the bottom.
cdh.sub.zh: 每部影片和剧集各占一行：它在 Studio 和 crazydramas.com 上的状态，以及下一步要做什么。还不能导入的影片收在最下面。

cdh.subProducer.en: Your films and titles: where each stands in Studio and on crazydramas.com, and the one next step.
cdh.subProducer.zh: 你的影片和剧集：每部在 Studio 和 crazydramas.com 上的状态，以及下一步要做什么。

cdh.studio.update.en: Files changed since: update on Import films
cdh.studio.update.zh: 导入后文件有变化：去“导入影片”更新

cdh.studio.made_in_studio.zh: 在 Studio 中创建 · {n} 集

cdh.cd.draft.zh: 草稿 · 已上传 {n}/{of} 集

cdh.cd.not_live.en: Not live (not uploaded, or a draft)
cdh.cd.not_live.zh: 未上线（未上传，或仍是草稿）

cdh.cd.elsewhere.en: Its address belongs to another series
cdh.cd.elsewhere.zh: 它的网址属于另一部剧

cdh.cd.before_import_unread.en: Not checked yet (read CrazyDramas, or import it)
cdh.cd.before_import_unread.zh: 尚未检查（读取 CrazyDramas，或先导入）

cdh.cd.before_import_unreadProducer.en: Not checked yet (Studio reads CrazyDramas every hour)
cdh.cd.before_import_unreadProducer.zh: 尚未检查（Studio 每小时读取一次 CrazyDramas）

cdh.read.done.en: Read CrazyDramas: {n} live series in its catalog.
cdh.read.done.zh: 已读取 CrazyDramas：目录中有 {n} 部上线的剧。

cdh.read.catalogFailed.en: CrazyDramas' catalog could not be read this time; the titles' own series were read. Try again in a minute.
cdh.read.catalogFailed.zh: 这次未能读取 CrazyDramas 的目录，各剧集自己的系列已读取。请 1 分钟后再试。

cdh.unmatchedMoved.en: Series live on CrazyDramas that match no film or title are listed on the CrazyDramas page.
cdh.unmatchedMoved.zh: 在 CrazyDramas 上线、但没有对应影片或剧集的剧，列在 CrazyDramas 页面。

cdh.catalogNotRead.en: The live series that match no film or title show here once CrazyDramas' catalog is read (every hour, or press Read CrazyDramas now).
cdh.catalogNotRead.zh: 读取 CrazyDramas 目录后（每小时一次，或点“立即读取 CrazyDramas”），这里会显示没有对应影片或剧集的上线剧。

cdh.noWorkspace.en: The film workspace is not connected, so only Studio's titles are listed.
cdh.noWorkspace.zh: 影片工作区尚未接入，因此只列出 Studio 中的剧集。

cdh.empty.en: No film or title yet. Films appear here once the cutting pipeline delivers them.
cdh.empty.zh: 还没有影片或剧集。切片流水线交付影片后，会出现在这里。

cdh.readOnly.notAdmin.en: Only a staff administrator imports, uploads and publishes; you can see where each film stands.
cdh.readOnly.notAdmin.zh: 只有员工管理员可以导入、上传和发布；你可以查看每部影片的状态。

cdh.readOnly.readOnly.en: Only your company's approver imports, uploads and publishes; you can see where each film stands.
cdh.readOnly.readOnly.zh: 只有你公司的审批人可以导入、上传和发布；你可以查看每部影片的状态。

cdh.readOnly.preview.en: You are previewing the producer portal as staff: the buttons are off. Staff act on the staff CrazyDramas page.
cdh.readOnly.preview.zh: 你正以员工身份预览制作方门户，按钮不可用。员工请在员工端的 CrazyDramas 页面操作。

fi.notReady.hint.en: rendering, not delivered yet, or a narrated work folder
fi.notReady.hint.zh: 渲染中、尚未交付，或是叙述式工作目录

fi.noneReady.en: No film is ready to import yet; the ones below are still on their way.
fi.noneReady.zh: 还没有可以导入的影片；下面的影片仍在处理中。

admin.title.importedHelp.en: The film's episodes as imported from the cutting pipeline, with their ad clips. Open one to watch it with its transcript.
admin.title.importedHelp.zh: 从切片流水线导入的分集及其广告切片。打开分集可以对照转写观看。

flow.label.en: From the film to its ad results

flow.what.segment.en: Cut the film into the series' episodes
flow.what.segment.zh: 把影片切成系列的分集

flow.what.upload.en: Put the series live on crazydramas.com
flow.what.upload.zh: 让系列在 crazydramas.com 上线

flow.what.clips.en: Short clips for ads, not episodes
flow.what.clips.zh: 用于广告的短切片，不是分集

flow.what.launch.en: Run the clips as ads on TikTok
flow.what.launch.zh: 把切片作为广告投放到 TikTok

flow.what.stats.en: What the ads cost and brought
flow.what.stats.zh: 广告花了多少、带来了什么

cdp.publish.progressHint.en: After you press Publish this closes and the Publish step shows the progress: the episodes, the series, then the public page.
cdp.publish.progressHint.zh: 按下发布后此面板会关闭，发布步骤里会显示进度：分集、系列，然后是公开页面。

cdp.progress.ep.none.en: No episodes in this publish: the series only.
cdp.progress.ep.none.zh: 这次不发布分集，只发布系列。

cdp.progress.ep.failed.zh: 已发布 {n}/{total} 集；第 {list} 集未发布。

cdp.progress.series.stays.en: The series stays a draft (“Also publish the series” was left unticked).
cdp.progress.series.stays.zh: 系列仍是草稿（没有勾选“同时让系列上线”）。

cdp.progress.series.blocked.en: The series stays a draft because episodes {list} could not be published.
cdp.progress.series.blocked.zh: 由于第 {list} 集未能发布，系列仍是草稿。

cdp.progress.series.failed.en: The series did not go live: {reason}

cdp.progress.public.running.en: Checking crazydramas.com… {s} s (its public pages can take up to a minute to catch up)
cdp.progress.public.running.zh: 正在检查 crazydramas.com… 已过 {s} 秒（公开页面最多约 1 分钟后才会更新）

cdp.progress.public.done.en: The public page shows the series with episodes {list}.
cdp.progress.public.done.zh: 公开页面已显示此系列及第 {list} 集。

cdp.progress.public.doneSeries.en: The public page shows the series.
cdp.progress.public.doneSeries.zh: 公开页面已显示此系列。

cdp.progress.public.late.en: The public page does not show it yet after {s} s. crazydramas' public pages can lag behind a publish; check again in a minute.
cdp.progress.public.late.zh: {s} 秒后公开页面仍未显示。crazydramas 的公开页面可能晚于发布更新，请 1 分钟后再检查。

cdp.progress.public.draft.en: Not needed: a draft series has no public page.
cdp.progress.public.draft.zh: 无需检查：草稿系列没有公开页面。

cdp.progress.public.notRun.en: Not checked: nothing new went live.
cdp.progress.public.notRun.zh: 未检查：没有新内容上线。

cdp.progress.live.draft.en: Published into the draft: viewers see these episodes once the series goes live.
cdp.progress.live.draft.zh: 已发布到草稿系列：系列上线后观众才能看到这些分集。

cdp.progress.live.notYet.en: Not confirmed yet: check the public page again.
cdp.progress.live.notYet.zh: 尚未确认：请再次检查公开页面。
